Zakres ustalam projektowo: od pojedyncze: The scope is agreed per project, from a single event to an extended temporary activation. For multiple dates in a season, compare rental and purchase.
Czy boisko może stanąć w hali?: Can the court be installed indoors?
Tak, arena stała już w hali podczas Head: Yes, an arena was installed indoors for the Head & Shoulders Freestyle Football Cup 2013. Suitability depends on the system, substrate, dimensions and venue conditions, so I check the location and installation access before quoting.
Tak. Branding może obejmować bandy, elem: Yes. Branding can cover boards, equipment and surrounding staging. Options depend on the court model and components.
Czy organizujecie cały turniej, czy tylk: Do you organise the whole tournament or just deliver the court?
Jedno albo drugie. Mogę dostarczyć samo: Either. I can deliver the court with transport and installation or prepare the entire sports element of the event: format, referees, hosting, DJ and branding.
Jak zorganizować turniej piłkarski dla d: How do you organise a football tournament for children?
W briefie określ wiek uczestników, liczb: Specify participant ages, number of teams, playing level and event duration in the brief. I then select the match format, breaks, rules and hosting. 1v1 and 3v3 formats make good use of small spaces, but waiting areas and spectators must also be planned.
Czy robicie turnieje dla firm i pracowni: Do you organise tournaments for companies and employees?
Tak. Ustalam liczbę drużyn, poziom uczes: Yes. I agree the number of teams, participant level, schedule, staffing and competition rules. The scope can include a mobile court, coordination, referees, hosting, DJ and branding.
Co jest potrzebne do wyceny?: What is needed for a quote?
Data, lokalizacja, zdjęcia miejsca, wymi: Date, location, venue photos, available dimensions, participant numbers and ages, and duration. Include whether you need only the court or also competition organisation, sound, branding and photography.
